thought.text: Transient issue — the `-l` login shell sources a profile with a podman shim. Let me retry without it.

reasoning_content: `docker context` and `docker info` are working now, and `docker exec` works fine too. The Podman error was a temporary issue where the `bash -lc` shell profile sourced a Docker/Podman shim (the container's environment variables include `container=podman`). I'll retry with a non-login shell (without -l).

action.command: docker exec audiominer-local-asr-service-1 sh -c "for d in /app/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/asr_service-*.dist-info /app/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/asr-service-*.dist-info; do [ -d \$d ] && echo \$d && grep -m1 '^Version:' \$d/METADATA 2>/dev/null; done; ls /app/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/ | grep -iE '^(asr|shared)' | head" 2>&1; echo "=== commit date ==="; git -C /workspace log -1 --format='%ci' 2>&1
